text: 10月14日，中国证监会主席吴清、财政部副部长郭婷婷在京共同会见了美国公众公司会计监督委员会（PCAOB）主席德梅特里奥斯·洛戈泰斯（Demetrios Logothetis）。双方就持续推进中美审计监管合作、增进资本市场审计监管交流等议题深入交换了意见。（证监会网站）
text_en: On October 14, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing and Vice Minister of Finance Guo Tingting jointly met in Beijing with Demetrios Logothetis, Chairman of the U.S. Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB). The two sides had an in-depth exchange of views on topics including continuing to advance China-U.S. audit regulatory cooperation and enhancing audit regulatory exchanges in the capital markets. (CSRC website)
